description: This file defines the BIFFwriter class used for writing BIFF (Binary Interchange File Format) streams in Excel files, including methods for handling byte order, writing records, and managing data size and continuation blocks.

classes.name: BIFFwriter
classes.description: A class for writing BIFF streams in Excel files, handling byte order, data appending, and record management.

methods.name: getByteOrder
methods.description: Determines and caches the byte order (endianness) of the architecture.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends binary data to the internal BIFF stream, handling record continuation if necessary.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Returns binary data, applying continuation handling if data exceeds limit.

methods.name: storeBof
methods.description: Writes a Beginning of File (BOF) record to indicate start of a BIFF stream.

methods.name: storeEof
methods.description: Writes an End of File (EOF) record to mark the end of a BIFF stream.

methods.name: writeEof
methods.description: Returns an EOF record as a string.

methods.name: addContinue
methods.description: Splits long BIFF records into CONTINUE blocks to adhere to size limits.
